description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Promulgated the Regulations for Issuance of Non Manipulation Certificate be effective from the date of Gazette publication
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the promulgation of new regulations under the Customs Ordinance. It establishes the legal framework for issuing Non-Manipulation Certificates, defines key terms, outlines procedures, and sets fees. The content focuses on regulatory matters and legal instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
